scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nischay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojna
other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed and not currently studying, seeking employment
Must have passed 12th (inter) from a government‑recognized institution in Bihar and have no higher education
Must be a permanent resident of the district in Bihar where the application is submitted
Must not have received any allowance, scholarship, student credit card, education loan or any other assistance from any source
Must not be employed (contract, permanent or temporary) or self‑employed
Must undergo compulsory training in language communication and basic computer knowledge; allowance for the last 5 months will be withheld until the training certificate is surrendered
Eligibility ends immediately upon obtaining any form of employment or self‑employment, and allowance payments will stop accordingly
benefits_summary: Provides a self‑help allowance of Rs. 1000 per month for a maximum period of two years.
